name: Rater8 Reviews Block
description: Embed aggregated Rater8 reviews and ratings in a block.
project_description:
The Rater8 Reviews Block is a custom Drupal block plugin designed to display reviews obtained from the Rater8 API. It allows site administrators to configure the block with a specific ID corresponding to a physician, which enables dynamic fetching and rendering of review data directly on the Drupal site. 

 This integration enhances user engagement by showcasing real-time reviews within the site's layout.

 Implementation: 

 
 Download and extract files in the module folder. 
 Enable module from the module list. 
 Just place a block (Rater8 Reviews) with ID where you want. 
 Clear Drupal cache.
